'''2022 Online Championship Series Playoffs''' was the Players Committee OCS playoff on GEMP, October–November 2022. [[Justin Desai]] defeated [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] in the Finals.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-ocs-playoffs/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' GEMP
* '''Dates:''' October–November 2022
